newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Omega Healthcare estimates up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Omega Healthcare estimates up.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Thursday it increased its funds from operations (FFO) estimate for Omega Healthcare Investors Inc in 1997 to $3.04 a share from $3.03 and the FFO estimate for 1998 to $3.24 from $3.21.
-- EVEREN also increased its intermediate price target to $35 from $34 and its long-term price target to $37 from $35.
-- EVEREN said the revisions reflect an initial and investment grade rating from Moody's Investors Service and expectations of an investment grade rating from Standard & Poor's Corp within 30 days.
-- EVEREN said it continues to rate Omega Healthcare outperformer for both the intermediate and long terms.
-- Omega Healthcare owns and manages health care facilities.
-- Its shares closed up 1/8 Thursday at 32.
